culprit_citations.quoted_text: Par amount is presented for debt investments, while the number of shares or units owned is presented for equity investments. Par amount is denominated in U.S. Dollars ("$" or "USD") unless otherwise noted, Australian Dollars ("AUD"), or Euros ("EUR").
EIP Consolidated, LLC (dba Everest Infrastructure) | Wireless Telecommunication Services | 10.09 % | S + 6.25 % | 12/07/28 | 6,255 | $ | 6,215 | $ | 6,224

findings.detail: Two cost_currency values were stored as U_EUR/U_AUD even though the SOI permits AUD/EUR only for par amount and presents cost/fair value in USD.

rationale: FX03 is a single-field currency-unit check on cost_currency. The source schedule distinguishes par amount from valuation columns: footnote 4 says AUD/EUR can apply to par amount when otherwise noted, while the cost/fair value columns in the SOI are presented with dollar signs. The observed extracted cost_currency values U_EUR and U_AUD therefore reflect a unit extraction or column mapping error rather than valid non-USD valuation fields.
